paragraphs.text: Pontotoc shut out Columbus 49–0 at home Friday, Oct. 30, giving the Warriors a senior-night win. The school’s athletics account posted the final, and the dated MaxPreps game record confirms the result.
The Warriors led 28–0 at halftime after scoring 21 points in the second quarter, according to the game’s quarter-by-quarter score. Columbus was held scoreless in all four periods.

The victory moves Pontotoc to 7–2 overall and 3–1 in the division, the school’s final graphic reports. It follows the previous week’s loss at New Hope, covered in our earlier county football report linked below.

Pontotoc is scheduled to close the regular season at Lafayette at 7 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 5. The official school schedule and both teams’ current listings agree on the date and time; the dated matchup is linked below for supporters to check for changes.
